questions.q: In which year did Deathstroke make his debut, in The New Teen Titans #2?
questions.why: Marv Wolfman and George Pérez introduced Deathstroke the Terminator in The New Teen Titans #2, dated December 1980.

questions.q: Which Marvel character was first modeled on Deathstroke's name, powers and costume?
questions.why: Rob Liefeld modeled Deadpool, whose real name is also Wade Wilson, on Deathstroke, who is Slade Wilson.

questions.q: Deathstroke's real name is Slade what?
questions.why: Deathstroke is Slade Joseph Wilson, a mercenary and former US Army soldier.

questions.q: In the comics, how does Slade gain his enhanced strength, speed and reflexes?
options: A radioactive spider bite at a research lab
questions.why: An experimental super-soldier serum boosted his body and mind far past human limits.

questions.q: What two colors make up Deathstroke's comic book mask, which covers his missing eye?
questions.why: A split black-and-orange mask covers his missing right eye and has become his visual trademark.

questions.q: Deathstroke is the archenemy of the Teen Titans and which former Robin?
questions.why: After his son Grant died, Slade swore revenge, which set him against Dick Grayson and the Titans.

questions.q: Slade's son Joseph fights alongside the Titans under which codename?
questions.why: Joseph Wilson is Jericho, who once transferred his consciousness into his father to take over his body.

questions.q: In The Judas Contract, which young hero helps Deathstroke by betraying the Titans' secret identities?
questions.why: The Titans trusted Terra with their identities, and Slade used that information to subdue them one by one.

questions.q: Who played Deathstroke in the 2017 film Justice League?
questions.why: Joe Manganiello played Deathstroke in Justice League and in Zack Snyder's director's cut.

questions.q: In the TV series Arrow, Slade is injected with which drug that drives him insane?
questions.why: On Arrow, Manu Bennett's Slade takes the Mirakuru super-soldier serum and blames Oliver Queen for his troubles.
